# ICF 2026 Code File Instructions

When creating or materially editing source files for this project:

- Add the one-line ICF AI disclosure if AI meaningfully assisted the file and the file format supports comments.
- Use `docs/AI_DISCLOSURE.md` for language-specific examples.
- Do not add invalid comments to strict data formats such as JSON.
- For config/data formats that cannot safely include comments, update the README AI disclosure section instead.
- Prefer readable names, small functions, explicit error states, and simple structure the student can explain.
- Add or update unit tests, automated checks, or manual test cases when the file changes behavior.
- Mention screenshot or recording evidence when the change affects UI or user flow.
